name: smwmusic-f-zero-death-wind
title: F-Zero - Death Wind
description:
A fast-paced tense song, played on the stage with the same name, from F-Zero.
I tried my best to rip the PWM / noise sample through the SPC, and make it play a good amount of loop, even though the sample is auto generated by the game engine.

There's an option on the text file to add the wind noises and the PWM / noise sample, in case you want to listen only to the song. If you want to add the wind noises, change the "Add_Wind_SFX" define to 1.
